assumptions: The null, feature/statistic, processing, row identities, tie convention, M, scales and alpha are fixed independently of the numerical refinement.

Same-sky SMICA/COMMANDER/NILC/SEVEM products are correlated controls; they cannot create independent replicate skies.

claims.derivation: The finite-rank proof only needs exchangeability of the fixed score vector. Conditional on its unordered values, at most floor(alpha M) indices have inclusive descending rank <=alpha M. A candidate confidence set instead needs the same level guarantee at every possible true candidate. Thus a single admitted isotropic null supports a null rejection claim, whereas physical confidence inversion needs a candidate family. Numerical enclosures support neither stochastic premise by themselves.

A high f_B or rejected isotropy score has no parameter-to-observation map to shear, vorticity or matter tilt. A best-fitting boost coordinate is not such a map.

claims.title: Threshold witnesses certify the unchanged full-orbit rank decision
equations: N=M-1; fix valid a<=s_0<=b.
Below witness for row i: k distinct j!=i with U_ij<a. Then s_i<=max_selected U_ij<a<=s_0.
High witness for row i: M-k distinct j!=i with L_ij>=b. At most k-1 remaining distances can be <b, hence s_i>=b>=s_0.
Let B_count be the number of certified below reference rows and H_count the number of certified high reference rows. Then (1+H_count)/M<=p<=(M-B_count)/M.
At alpha=1/20, certify rejection if B_count>=M-floor(M/20); certify non-rejection if H_count>=floor(M/20).
Observed bracket witnesses: k edges with U_0j<=b prove s_0<=b; M-k edges with L_0j>=a prove s_0>=a.
For any pivot h: L_ij <- max(L_ij,L_ih-U_jh,L_jh-U_ih,0); U_ij <- min(U_ij,U_ih+U_hj).
assumptions: Every bound concerns the same amplitude-preserving common-SO(3) metric with fixed positive q0,o0 and all original tensor rows retained.
Group action is isometric in the fixed weighted Frobenius norm; quotient metric/pseudometric triangle inequalities follow.
Bounds are simultaneously deterministic certificates with outward arithmetic, or one entire-run simultaneous failure allocation delta is deducted from alpha.
Edge witnesses use distinct row indices, never count the diagonal, and persist exact target/statistic/law identities.
claims.derivation: The two kth-order statements are direct counting lemmas. A below row is certainly not an inclusive exceedance; a high row is certainly an inclusive exceedance. Remaining rows stay possible, giving the p enclosure without determining their scores. At every adaptive numerical stop this upper endpoint still bounds the same exact p pointwise, so observed-directed scheduling adds no optional-stopping penalty. The quotient triangle bound follows by composing rotations for X_i-to-X_h and X_h-to-X_j and applying the Euclidean triangle inequality; compactness supplies minimizing rotations, though infimum approximations alone suffice. Replacing unknown exact distances by certified interval endpoints yields the stated propagation.
algorithm: Initialize every row identity and a complete cheap enclosure bank (or a lazy representation whose finite identity upper and zero lower are reproducibly defined for every pair); no row deletion or fabricated missing-row enclosure.
Maintain a certified observed kth bracket, below/high reference witness lists, and a monotone pair certificate store.
Propagate triangle bounds through a small adaptively chosen pivot set. A pivot is a computational choice only; it does not alter the statistic.

Before refining an edge, determine which observed bracket or row threshold witness it can complete. Prefer useful cheap feasible-rotation upper witnesses for below rows; use invariant/pivot/global lower certificates for high rows.
Stop immediately at the integer decision condition. Otherwise refine only relevant ambiguous comparisons using exact threshold or enclosure routines.

On deadline or unresolved ties, emit the valid interval, UNRESOLVED, target hash, source/row binding, witness lists and first failure. A supervisor deadline/new operation budget belongs to a new computation plan; never relabel the historical 60-second failure.

When a=0, no nonnegative distance can prove a below witness. Improving only reference upper bounds then cannot establish rejection; the observed lower bracket must improve.
Triangle bounds need the common fixed group metric. Distances after row-dependent scales, masks or covariance norms need a new proof and can violate the claimed metric relation.
limitations: This is a sufficient decision certificate, not a runtime theorem or proof it will resolve existing M301/M1000 pools.

The M1000 rejection certificate needs at most 950*32 explicitly selected below-edge witnesses before deduplicating, but discovering them and certifying s_0 may cost much more. This is a certificate-size observation, not a complexity bound.

claims.title: SO(3) threshold comparison is a compact sextic polynomial problem
equations: Let h=(w,x,y,z)!=0, r=h^T h, and H(h) be the usual homogeneous degree-two quaternion rotation numerator, so R(h)=H/r in SO(3).
P_t(h)=r^3(f(R(h))^2-t^2); P_t is homogeneous of degree six.
For t>=0, d(X,Y)<t iff some chart h_c=1, h_j in [-1,1], has P_t(h)<0.
For t>=0, d(X,Y)>=t iff P_t(h)>=0 on all four chart cubes.
assumptions: Tensor/scaling/threshold values are rational, including exact dyadic interpretations of finite binary64 rows; t>=0.
The isometry identities ||RQ'R^T||=||Q'|| and ||R^{tensor 3}O'||=||O'|| are used before clearing denominators.
Four largest-component quaternion charts cover all proper rotations, including overlap and boundary ties.
claims.derivation: Expanding the squared residual uses fixed tensor norms and two correlation terms. The Q correlation denominator is r^2 and the O correlation denominator r^3. Multiplying by r^3 gives the sextic expression; a direct unsimplified squared-residual expansion would misleadingly suggest degree twelve. Because r>0, the threshold inequality keeps its sign. A nonnegative global polynomial certificate proves a lower threshold; a strict negative rational witness proves a feasible upper comparison. Dense rational chart points guarantee an exact rational witness exists whenever the strict negative open set is nonempty.
algorithm: Expose compare_orbit_to_threshold(pair_id,t)->LT_CERTIFIED | GE_CERTIFIED | UNKNOWN with exact certificate data.
Try feasible rational quaternion witness, spectral/pivot lower thresholds and existing interval branch-and-bound first.

If exact equality or a small margin obstructs interval termination, allow a separately qualified rational CAD/quantifier-elimination or verified polynomial-positivity fallback on the four compact cubes.
Use rationally checked SOS/Positivstellensatz output only at its actual proof scope. A failed SOS relaxation is UNKNOWN; arbitrary nonnegative sextics need not admit the selected SOS representation.
Keep hard resource accounting and return UNKNOWN rather than accepting local minima or approximate solver statuses as global certificates.

claims.title: Existing f_B admits an exact ideal conditional null for a separate fixed statistic
equations: For fixed Q!=0, B_Q beta=3 beta_<a Q_bc>, B_Q^*B_Q=3 M_Q, M_Q=(Q:Q)I+(6/5)Q^2; rank B_Q=3.
If O|Q=q ~ N(0,sigma3^2 I_7) in a Frobenius-orthonormal STF3 basis, then X=||P_q O||^2/sigma3^2~chi2_3, Y=||(I-P_q)O||^2/sigma3^2~chi2_4, independently.
Therefore f_B=X/(X+Y)~Beta(3/2,2), conditional on every admitted q!=0.

More generally, for an admitted central conditional Gaussian after correct whitening/nuisance removal with m dimensions and fixed conditional projector rank r, f=||P_D y||^2/||y||^2~Beta(r/2,(m-r)/2), 0<r<m.
assumptions: An admitted ideal full-sky central isotropic conditional octupole law; Gaussian independent full-sky l=2/l=3 blocks suffice, but not every processed product obeys it.
Frobenius-orthonormal coordinates or the exact STF3 Gram metric are required. The seven unique Cartesian components do not have identity metric.
The statistic and one-sided tail are fixed in a new scientific lane; no data-driven scan over statistic, product, axis, null or tail.
Domain handling for Q=0/O=0 and numerical refusal is fixed without selectively dropping observed/simulated rows.
The general whitened version uses the actual conditional mean and covariance; conditioning on measured Q must be justified by that joint law.
claims.derivation: An orthonormal basis diagonalizing the rank-three projector splits a spherical seven-dimensional Gaussian into independent 3- and 4-dimensional blocks. Their squared norms are independent chi-square variables with a common scale, so the ratio is Beta. The Beta density is (15/4)f^(1/2)(1-f), whose direct integral gives the stated CDF. Unknown common sigma3 cancels. This is a mathematically calibrated partial diagnostic under an explicit law, not a replacement for the amplitude-sensitive nine-dimensional common orbit.

evidence.scope: Actual existing f_B is the squared norm fraction, matching this derivation; stored products remain unqualified.

numerical_checks.exact_check: CDF transformed by f=v^2 gives (5v^3-3v^5)/2; endpoint normalization equals one by exact Fraction arithmetic. No observed p was computed.

counterexamples: Replacing O by lambda O for lambda!=0 leaves f_B invariant while changing the fixed-scale full Q/O orbit unless |lambda|=1 in special cases. This statistic discards amplitude and other morphology information.
An anisotropic or Q-correlated processed octupole need not have the Beta law without correct conditional centering/whitening. PR3 same-sky control metadata supplies no such law.
A large f_B also arises from an intrinsic octupole lying in Im B_Q; it does not identify a physical velocity.
claims.next_capability: Minimal prospective alternative: freeze f_B or a fixed covariance-aware projection statistic and obtain a release-matched null/conditional law. It needs neither pairwise SO(3) optimization nor a Bianchi solver. Ideal Beta is an exact mock/control law only until actual processing assumptions are admitted.

claims.title: The stochastic conditional boost response includes reverse mixing
equations: For d=1 on the full sky, G_i f=n_i f-grad(n_i) dot grad(f). Since Delta n_i=-2n_i, <f,G_i g>+<G_i f,g>=0; G_i^*=-G_i.
In orthonormal real harmonics let B_i: l=2 -> l=3 and E_i: l=3 -> l=2. Then E_i=-B_i^T.
At first order q=q_s+sum_i beta_i E_i o_s+other adjacent inputs; o=o_s+sum_i beta_i B_i q_s+other adjacent inputs.
For independent zero-mean source blocks Cov(q_s)=C2 I_5, Cov(o_s)=C3 I_7, C2,C3>0, derivative_i Cov(o,q)=(C2-C3)B_i.
Consequently E[o|q]=sum_i beta_i (1-C3/C2) B_i q+O(||beta||^2), under the joint Gaussian source law and near beta=0.
In a general Gaussian processed law d=K_beta s+n, mu_beta=K_beta m, Sigma_beta=K_beta S K_beta^T+Sigma_n(beta). Derivative_i Sigma=K_i S K_0^T+K_0 S K_i^T+derivative_i Sigma_n.
The Gaussian information contains both terms I_ij=(derivative_i mu)^T Sigma^-1(derivative_j mu)+(1/2)tr(Sigma^-1(derivative_i Sigma)Sigma^-1(derivative_j Sigma)).
assumptions: This is a first-order, zero-boost, ideal full-sky stochastic derivation with orthonormal real coordinates and d=1; C2,C3 denote source per-mode variances in those coordinates, not tensor amplitudes.
Other source multipoles are independent at beta=0, so their adjacent contributions do not add to this l=2/l=3 cross block at first order.
The absolute monopole/corrections, intrinsic dipole, mask, beams, selection and noise must be handled separately for an actual product.
A deterministic fixed-source derivative and a stochastic conditional/marginal derivative are distinct experiments.
claims.derivation: The divergence theorem gives skew-adjointness of the full-sky temperature generator. Therefore the reverse l=3-to-2 block is minus the transpose of the forward block. Cross covariance receives a C2 B_i term from boosting q_s into o and a C3 E_i^T term from boosting o_s into q. Their difference is essential. Gaussian conditioning multiplies that cross covariance by (C2 I)^(-1), giving the corrected conditional regression. Merely inserting observed Q into O approximately B_Q beta ignores the fact that Q itself is boosted and random.

numerical_checks.axisymmetric_z: Using standard Legendre polynomials with exact rational coefficient arithmetic: G P2=(9/5)P3-(4/5)P1; G P3=(16/7)P4-(9/7)P2. All coefficient residuals exactly zero. In normalized modes the forward/reverse coefficients are +9/sqrt(35), -9/sqrt(35), and the weighted adjoint residual is zero.
numerical_checks.counterexample: Set C2=C3>0. The l=2/l=3 first-order conditional mean response is zero although B_Q has rank three for every Q!=0. Thus algebraic inverse existence does not imply first-order statistical beta information in this block.

equations: Under a separately admitted fixed-design Gaussian model z=A beta_obs+N eta+b+epsilon, epsilon~N(0,I), beta_obs=v_obs/c, let U span col(N)^perp, y=U^T z, D=U^T A, b'=U^T b.
For fixed b', r=rank D: C_b'(y)={beta: ||P_D(y-D beta-b')||^2<=chi2_r(1-alpha)} has coverage >=1-alpha.
For deterministic discrepancy set B', C(y)=union_{b' in B'} C_b'(y), or a certified outer approximation, preserves coverage when the true discrepancy is included.
A linear beta target L beta is estimable only when ker D is contained in ker L; equivalently row L is contained in row D.
The orthogonal residual (I-P_D)y diagnoses mismatch separately; adding its rejection to the confidence rule requires an explicit combined calibration/allocation.
Full-sky tensor amplitudes: ||B_Q beta||_F^2=3 beta^T M_Q beta. B_Q rank three and kappa(M_Q)<=5/3 do not survive arbitrary processing/nuisance projection automatically.
assumptions: Fixed positive-definite selected covariance and fixed nuisance/response design are explicit local contracts. An observed-Q plug-in response needs the conditional-law justification of CMB-05.
Mean approximation errors have a declared deterministic image and uniform validity region; covariance/selection changes require their own law qualification.
If a proper rotation relates product frames, rotate Q,O and their full covariance consistently before sharing a beta/directional parameter with other observations.

claims.derivation: At the true beta,b', projecting onto col D gives a rank-r central Gaussian squared norm. Taking the union over the allowed deterministic discrepancy can only enlarge the confidence region. Projecting out a fixed nuisance eliminates its exact mean image but may also eliminate the physical response. Information lives only in the quotient response. The independent orthogonal component is a goodness-of-fit diagnostic under the same fixed Gaussian law, not part of the r-dimensional parameter pivot by default.

counterexamples: Choose N=A. Then D=0 even if the unprocessed local B_Q has rank three. All beta values remain admissible absent other restrictions.
A tiny quadrupole leaves kappa(M_Q) bounded while the absolute information scale tends to zero like ||Q||^2; good relative conditioning does not mean a precise velocity.
An unconstrained intrinsic octupole can absorb B_Q delta_beta exactly; the algebraic least-squares coordinate alone cannot distinguish it from a local boost.
